svg.title: open-sb providers and capabilities
svg.desc: One interface, open-sb, over 17 sandbox providers: E2B, Daytona, Vercel Sandbox, Modal, Fly Sprites, Fly Machines, Runloop, CodeSandbox, Morph Cloud, Blaxel, Upstash Box, Freestyle, HOPX, Beam, Boat, Agent37, Docker. A mark shows each optional capability a provider supports.
svg.text: one interface · 17 sandbox providers · one config file
Every provider also has create, get, list, destroy, exec, readFile and writeFile
